press_references.value: Navan And Engine Announce Strategic Technology Partnership To Power New Capabilities In Business Travel

partnership_announcements.description: Navan and Engine announced a strategic technology partnership integrating Engine’s lodging, infrastructure, and payment capabilities into Navan’s business travel platform. Initial capabilities are scheduled to roll out in September 2026, with additional group-booking and self-service features planned for subsequent months.

press_references.value: Navan Selected by Evotec for Global Travel, Expense Management

partnership_announcements.description: Evotec has selected Navan as its global travel and expense management platform, establishing a new commercial partnership for corporate travel and T&E services.

press_references.value: Navan Unveils 'Navan Anywhere' to Let Users Book Travel Across Platforms via AI Agents, Starting with Gemini Enterprise

partnership_announcements.description: Navan and Google Cloud launched a collaboration that embeds Navan’s AI travel agents into Gemini Enterprise via Google Cloud Marketplace, allowing users to plan, book, and manage travel directly inside Gemini’s interface as part of the new Navan Anywhere strategy.

press_references.value: Schindler Selects Navan to Elevate Global Travel Operations

partnership_announcements.description: Navan and Schindler Group entered into a new partnership under which Navan will provide its travel and expense management platform to modernize and unify Schindler's global travel operations across North America and Europe.

partnership_announcements.description: Navan announced a new strategic partnership with global consultancy Simon-Kucher, which will use Navan's AI-powered travel and expense platform to manage its global travel program across more than a dozen markets.

press_references.value: Navan Accelerates NDC Adoption with New Emirates Partnership

partnership_announcements.description: Navan has formed a new strategic NDC integration partnership with Emirates, creating a direct connection that delivers Emirates fares and services to Navan’s corporate travel platform users.

about_short_description.short_description: Navan provides travel, expense, and corporate card management to automate manual processes and drive spend visibility.

product.name: Navan Travel
product.description: A business travel management platform for searching, booking, and managing flights, hotels, rail, and rental cars within company policies and budgets.

product.name: Navan Expense
product.description: An expense management platform that automates transaction capture, categorization, reporting, approvals, reimbursements, and reconciliation.

product.name: Navan Payments
product.description: A corporate payments solution supporting Navan-issued cards, linked existing corporate cards, virtual cards, and reimbursements for employee out-of-pocket spending.

product.name: Navan Events
product.description: An event management service for sourcing venues and coordinating company meetings, offsites, and other business events end to end.

product.name: Navan Advanced Analytics
product.description: A travel and expense analytics capability that provides interactive dashboards, spend analysis, trend exploration, alerts, and real-time program visibility.

product.name: Navan Edge
product.description: An AI travel assistant for managing flights, hotels, and restaurants, with access to human travel support through chat.
